title: RoomsFromLayerResult
description: Room markers (boundary curves) created from closed room curves

forsk_ids.description: forsk:id values parallel to ids (r01, r02, …)

plate_ids.description: GUIDs of the floor plates (forsk:kind room_plate), one per room the walls close. All plates are rebuilt with the markers.

why.description: gap 0.9 m without a door, its walls do not close, ...

no_plate.description: Rooms with a marker but no plate, because the walls do not close them; the message names them.
